**Paimon:** Huh? Gravity seems back to normal...

**Paimon:** Columbina! You're back! Was it you who fixed the problem just now? Talk about perfect timing...

**Paimon:** We were so worried! Where did you go?

- **Traveler:** Are you alright?

**Columbina:** I'm sorry. I didn't expect the depths of this base to actually lead to the moon's core. It contains an extremely high concentration of ancient moon energy.

**Columbina:** When I suffused this base with kuuvahki, I accidentally came into contact with it and was swept into the moon's core.

**Paimon:** Anyway, Paimon's glad you're okay! We just discovered some new info about Project Moongazer. It's...

**Columbina:** I discovered who you are as well, Ninnin.

**Columbina:** Hmm...

**Paimon:** What's wrong, Columbina? You look like you don't want her to go there..

**Columbina:** Ninnin... cannot survive within the moon's core.

**Eggie:** But I must complete my mission.

**Columbina:** Yes, but it does not wait for you there.

**Eggie:** What?

**Columbina:** Your mission isn't to be accomplished at the moon's core. Rather, it is to be found in the place where everything began.

**Paimon:** You mean the Eye of Ibni-Belum?

**Columbina:** Yes, your mission is to activate Project Moongazer within the Eye.

**Columbina:** That requires a data key made from the ancient moon's power. I can journey to the moon's core once again to retrieve it for you, but it will take some time.

**Eggie:** Are you asking me... to return to the Eye and wait?

**Columbina:** Would that be alright with you?

**Eggie:** ...No. If I can't get the key myself... I'll wait for you here.

**Eggie:** If you don't come back... I won't leave.

**Eggie:** I want to stay here... and wait for my friend to return...

**Columbina:** I understand. Thank you, Ninnin. I'll be right back.

- **Traveler:** I'll go with you, Columbina.

**Columbina:** If you insist.

**Paimon:** H—Hang on, what about Eggie? Are we really going to leave her here all alone?

**Columbina:** Don't worry, I sent a message to Maagees, and she's on her way.

**Columbina:** As long as she stays here, there's nothing else in this base that can harm her.

**Paimon:** Paimon's still a little worried, though. Maybe she should just stay here and keep Eggie company?

**Columbina:** Huh? Don't you want to see what the moon's core looks like?

**Paimon:** Yeah, but Eggie will get lonely here if we leave her all alone.

**Paimon:** She's also Lusalim's daughter, which is, well, something she only just found out.

**Paimon:** News like that always takes some time to digest. And it's not easy to handle — what if she starts to overthink things and runs off somewhere dangerous?

**Paimon:** So, Paimon's gonna stay here with her and wait for Maagees.

**Paimon:** Just make sure to come back and tell Paimon what you see, okay?

**Eggie:** Thank you, Paimon. My estimation of you has gone up once again.

**Paimon:** In that case, Paimon will increase your snack allowance by one share! Now it's three for you and seven for Paimon.

- **Traveler:** Paimon, acting like a big sister... How quickly they grow.

**Paimon:** Heh, why so surprised? Paimon did watch Eggie grow up, y'know!

**Paimon:** Alright, go on, go on! The sooner you go, the sooner you'll be back. Don't make us wait too long!

**Columbina:** Alright. Traveler, come with me.

**Nin-Kiggia's Mark:** You might inherit the name of someone who came before us through the ocean of data, or you might not, but you will probably recall that you have a mission.

**Nin-Kiggia's Mark:** Then came the first Moongazer, Ibni-Belum, who led us to the moon, opened our eyes, and tirelessly gazed into the brilliant starry skies.

**Nin-Kiggia's Mark:** Finally, dear successor, thank you as well for your imminent sacrifice, which will activate the final step of our project.

**Nin-Kiggia's Mark:** Your mission is to continue transmitting the message we once received out into the universe.

**Nin-Kiggia's Mark:** "A single ray of light is feeble, easily swallowed by the darkness, but as long as another light shines out before it can fade..."

**Nin-Kiggia's Mark:** "Then one day, there will surely come a ray of light that pierces the night like the dawn."

**Nin-Kiggia's Mark:** I imagine you understand what I mean at this point, yes? As it happens, my time is almost up... But that's okay. I'll be joining them all soon.

**Nin-Kiggia's Mark:** Come to think of it, you might actually have inherited my name, hehe.

**Nin-Kiggia's Mark:** It's time to say goodbye. Go complete your mission. And lastly... I salute you, and all your fellow Mo(starry sky)ongazers.

**Columbina:** And that's everything.

**Columbina:** All the researchers who once explored the starry sky have had their data merged into this ocean. By the will of the moon, they will be reborn at some point in the future in forms akin to Eggie's.

**Columbina:** They will instinctively consume each other to acquire more data until the mission becomes clear in their minds.

**Columbina:** Then they will walk the path we have walked once more, come here, and learn everything.

**Columbina:** They will use themselves as keys to open the Moongazer module in the Eye of Ibni-Belum, and resend the message out into the universe.

- **Traveler:** Then, they will return to the cycle of life...

**Columbina:** Yes, and this cycle may have already happened more than once.

**Columbina:** That said, calling out into unknown space is not necessarily safe.

**Columbina:** The dragon researchers must have also realized this, which is why they began work on the Lunar Veil.

**Columbina:** And in Ninnin's era, the world already teetered on the brink of destruction due to the conflict between two supreme beings.

**Columbina:** But peace has been restored in Teyvat, at least for now.

- **Traveler:** (If the signal sent out this time ends up drawing the attention of the darkness that dwells amidst the stars to this place...)

**Columbina:** As promised, I will hand the key and the message over to Ninnin.

**Columbina:** But do you think we should stop her from completing her mission? Or should we support her?

**Columbina:** Don't worry. Maagees will pick them up.

**Columbina:** It'll be a fairly long journey. We'll have plenty of time to give this some more thought.
